in_hebrew.name: ברקוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Barcus in Hebrew is derived from the Hebrew word ברק (baraq), which means 'lightning, flash of lightning'. This name may have been given to a child born during a thunderstorm or to signify divine protection from lightning.

in_greek.name: Βαρκούς
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Barcus in Greek is derived from the Greek word βαρκός (barkos), which means 'swift, strong, bearer'. This name may have been given to a child who was expected to be fleet of foot or to have the strength and ability to carry heavy loads.

in_latin.name: Barcus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Barcus in Latin is derived from the Latin word barcus, which means 'swift, strong'. This name may have been given to a child who was expected to be fleet of foot or to have the strength and ability to carry heavy loads.
